alt: 學生熱情介紹華麗的社團海報，另一手藏在背後比著手勢，聽者露出疑惑神情。
scene_prompt: A student cheerfully presents an exaggeratedly dazzling handmade club poster while hiding crossed fingers behind their back; a classmate listens but looks uncertain. Attractive but insincere words, shown without hostility. Natural anatomy, plausible poster support and classroom furniture.
